# Akin

> Akin is a free, mobile-first streak tracker that turns daily goals into a playful routine with coins, friends, and a customizable capybara companion.

Akin can be tried without an account. Guest streaks stay in the browser; GitHub sign-in adds cross-device data, a profile, rewards, pet customization, and social features.

## Product guide

- [Akin overview](https://akin.4oli.com/index.md): Concise, LLM-friendly product facts, guest and account behavior, features, and suitable use cases.
- [Akin](https://akin.4oli.com/): Product page and entry point to the streak tracker.
- [Interactive demo](https://akin.4oli.com/demo): Account-free demo with example streaks and app features.
